messages.subject: #346 minfix: Task 3 halted again after the operator review (option C); Tasks 4-8 not built
messages.body: Completed 2 of 8 plan tasks (T1, T2 compliant). Task 3 (fixcheck --enforce) used the full retry ladder (halt review=5 reason=ladder-end), then under your option C I fixed F5.1 in code with regression tests and F5.2 by undoing joins plus a corrected docstring, and the fresh operator review resolved all 8 earlier findings but found one new blocking finding, F6.1, which I reproduced: the new line-break restore step moves an in-budget appended sentence into its own paragraph when it starts with the same word as the next paragraph (BASE plus ' Backups also copy the cache.' after OLD; plain check exit 0, --enforce rewrites the spec with line-breaks=1), so the ledger now ends 'T3: blocked verdict=missing ...' and 'T3: halt review=5 reason=operator-review' and per your ruling I stopped without building Tasks 4-8. Results: new tests '84 passed in 1.95s'; new + spec-panel keep-green + routing/install tests '1502 passed in 6.82s'; make lint 'All checks passed!' (exit 0); ruff on the two new files 'All checks passed!'. Not built or verified from the SPEC: the sc-fixcheck SKILL.md, the spec-panel-minfix command and its pin tests, the routing_refresh edit, sync-dev mirror, the 472-base experiment build file, INSTALL.md, the briefs, the sed file and probe fixtures; the package is not archived (no FINAL ran, tasks incomplete), and fixcheck.py/test file are untracked product files, not staged. Departures from the plan: (1) plan amended in step A before start (R-001..R-004, owner rulings, stable brief paths); (2) owner rulings after start recorded in artifacts/owner-rulings-after-start.md: variant base is the 472-line file, and snapshot/check --enforce move to coordinator-inserted steps (no Ruling lines written yet, since Tasks 5/8 were not reached); (3) retry brief 3 used region composition instead of per-run line rules, brief 4 added a structure loop, brief 5 added a recheck branch; (4) operator-fix additions beyond the briefs: line-break restore, word-level fence repair, whole-gap rule limited to gaps with insertions; (5) adviser A's escalation-1 answer was saved before adviser B returned (no effect); (6) GPT top-rung adviser had no spawn path, so the family-fallback header is in artifacts/retries/T3/advice-3-b.md; (7) known limits found: neighbour attribution (note F4.2, 267 of 15,164 pairwise cases already flagged by plain check) and F6.1 above. Fix direction for F6.1 is in artifacts/retries/T3/review-5.md.
